channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran says seven ships hit in Hormuz Strait, warns US of wider response
item.description: The US has pushed back on the IRGC's claims, dismissing them as an attempt to increase oil prices ahead of US elections.

item.title: Foreign national beaten to death by a mob in South Africa
item.description: Police say a 50-person mob in Durban killed a man amid a wave of anti-migrant marches.

item.title: Two Syrian security officers killed in raid on ISIL cell near Damascus
item.description: The Syrian Interior Ministry says five suspected fighters killed and six arrested outside of Damascus.

item.title: Israeli attacks kill four as famine risk looms in Gaza
item.description: Four Palestinians killed as Israeli military expands control across Gaza, displacing millions and destroying homes.

item.title: Netanyahu promises Iran regime change: Can Israel topple Tehran government?
item.description: Israel can inflict devastating damage on Iran, but analysts question its ability to overthrow Tehran’s government.

item.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
item.description: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.

item.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
item.description: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

item.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
item.description: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.

item.title: How do Israel's elections work and who are the main contenders?
item.description: Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications.

item.title: How Arab parties could hold critical balance of power in Israeli election
item.description: Disaffection has often driven down turnout among Arab Israelis, but there is a strong push to get rid of the right-wing governing coalition.
